description: Returns how the numbers are made, as one object: the landmark model (478-point MediaPipe) and engine version, every classification threshold (face shape, eye, lip, nose, pupillary distance), how the 1-10 score is built, its validity against 2,513 human raters on the same faces (Spearman correlations with 95% intervals; the score did not predict them) and notes, optionally with the dated change history. Use this to explain or check how a number, threshold or score is computed, or whether the score means anything; use get_reference_statistics for the measured values themselves, get_face_type for one type's rule, and get_citation for how to credit the data. Read-only; the response is large.

include_changelog.description: true to also return the dated method change history (changelog entries). Default false: methodology only.

name: get_methodology
title: Methodology, thresholds and validity
